metrics.ev_stops_at_red_mean: Stops at red per emergency vehicle

data.loadErrorLive: The backend does not answer. Start it (see README) or switch back to the "Real results" source in the settings.
data.noDataText: This combination was not evaluated in our experiments.
data.pendingText: These measurements come from the extra simulations still running; run the export again when they finish.
data.provenanceText: Every number comes from the project's result files (results/). 95% confidence intervals by bootstrap over training runs and test seeds.

overview.byControllerText: Mean and 95% confidence interval. Lower is better unless stated.
overview.overTimeText: Mean over test seeds, minute by minute; the grey band is the measured window.
overview.headline: {{controller}} cuts {{metric}} by {{value}} against {{reference}}

analytics.forestText: Paired improvement over the reference, with 95% CI. Right of zero: better than the reference.
analytics.heatmapText: Gain (%) of each controller over the reference, scenario by scenario.
analytics.tableText: Mann-Whitney U test (rank-based, no normality assumption), Holm correction per family; effect: Cliff's delta.
analytics.distributionText: Vehicles per 15 s waiting bin, per run.
analytics.noComparisons: No test for this metric and controller.

agents.trainingText: One curve per training seed: reward per episode and halted vehicles (moving average over 5 episodes).
agents.rewardTermsText: Mean terms per decision during the measured window, normalised as in training (configs/reward_norm).
agents.decisionsText: Each agent decision: requested phase, phase executed after the safety shield, and its readable reason.
agents.noTraining: No learning curve for this combination.

pedestrians.waitingText: Mean, P95 and maximum wait at crossings.
pedestrians.greensText: Mean length of a pedestrian green by the number of people waiting when it starts (extra runs).
pedestrians.tradeoffText: Each point is a controller: pedestrian wait against vehicle wait.

emergency.delayText: Delay against the free-flow trip, by scenario and controller.
emergency.sideEffectText: Emergency delay against the mean wait of all vehicles.
emergency.logText: Each emergency vehicle of the extra runs: stops at red within 30 m of a signal, ETA estimated at departure and its error.

replay.noReplayText: Record one with scripts/record_replay.py, then run the export again.
replay.clickJunction: Click a signalised junction to see its state.
replay.controls3d: Drag: rotate · Wheel: zoom · Right-drag: pan
replay.webglMissing: 3D needs WebGL, which this browser does not provide.
